justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Across ASHA BCS specialties, no comparative outcome studies vs non-certified SLPs.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ASHA BCS portfolio plus exam across specialties; significant documentation requirements.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicability varies by SLP specialty area; each specialty has moderate breadth within its domain.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No billing premium across any ASHA BCS specialty; professional signaling credential only.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer recognition across ASHA BCS portfolio; low differentiation from standard SLP credentials.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Specialty credentialing signals expertise to patients and referrers.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Specialties like swallowing, child language, and fluency support strong private-pay practices, especially pediatrics and AAC.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Board certification supports premium rates within the SLP market.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Few SLPs hold BCS credentials, creating real scarcity and defensibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Other SLPs can be trained/hired under a BCS-led program, scaling reasonably.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Parents and families do search for board-certified specialists in fluency and child language.
justifications.business.efficiency: Multi-year mentored pathway with significant clinical hour requirements.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Highly regarded for SLP faculty positions, equivalent in spirit to PT board specialties.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: BCS holders publish heavily and lead specialty literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Core to CSD curricula — directly aligned with specialty courses.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Built on the strongest evidence within each SLP specialty area.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred or required in CSD faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Long mentored pathway, but high academic payoff.
